shadow.$description: React Native shadow scale for NativeWind v3. iOS uses shadowColor/Offset/Opacity/Radius, Android uses elevation. All props merged flat per token. Compiled separately via Style Dictionary for the react-native platform target.

0.$description: No shadow. Maps to NativeWind shadow-none.

100.$description: Subtle lift — cards, buttons at rest. Maps to NativeWind shadow-sm.

200.$description: Low elevation — hovering cards, raised sections. Maps to NativeWind shadow (base).

300.$description: Medium elevation — dropdowns, popovers. Maps to NativeWind shadow-md.

400.$description: High elevation — modals, dialogs. Maps to NativeWind shadow-lg.

500.$description: Highest elevation — toasts, command palettes. Maps to NativeWind shadow-xl.
